capture_action: Show main menu with START RUN visible
caption: Start a sky route
notes: Quick push-in from menu; no fake buttons.

capture_action: Tap START RUN and show first jumps
caption: Tap to begin
voiceover: Tap start and keep the jump moving.
notes: Use actual tap and first auto-jump.

capture_action: Hold LEFT then RIGHT and land on two pads
caption: Hold to steer
voiceover: Hold left or right to steer each landing.
notes: Controls and landing feedback must be visible.

capture_action: Collect gold signal motes while climbing
caption: Collect signal motes
voiceover: Collect signal motes for route progress.
notes: Let score or progress change remain visible.

capture_action: Approach and avoid a red warning spark
caption: Avoid warning sparks
voiceover: Read the red sparks before you commit.
notes: Hazard must be readable before the dodge.

capture_action: Show route stamps score or route complete
caption: Complete route stamps
voiceover: Finish the route and chase a cleaner climb.
notes: Use only real HUD or result state.

capture_action: Show result screen and restart action
caption: Restart fast
voiceover: Restart fast and try for your best score.
notes: Avoid ad or rewarded revive UI.
